title: GMT dated pay-month intake and correction contract

ownership.storage: GMT Web-App SharePoint / Shared Documents / Timesheets

recordIdentity.rowKey: Use the original source submission ID; for dated weekly rows, append the source Date as emitted by GMT Timesheet Record JSON.
recordIdentity.csvProducerRule: Weekly CSV rows include Employee, Employee email and Source record ID matching the structured JSON recordId; clock CSV rows include Employee, Employee email, Action and the original gmt_record_id as Source record ID.

observedLive.trigger: Shared mailbox V2 on accounts8765@gmtelectservsltd.onmicrosoft.com / Inbox; this address is absent from the loaded Exchange mailbox list and the trigger has reported ErrorInvalidUser
observedLive.recordFilter: Only non-inline application/json attachments whose name contains GMT Timesheet Record -
observedLive.indexOrdering: Create item precedes attachment validation and Excel Run script; source ID is Outlook message ID
observedLive.heldCorrections: Michelle, Matthew and Simon protected queue entries currently have XLSX and CSV only, so this JSON filter cannot run their workbook update

requiredTrigger.rule: Choose a connector/connection that demonstrably has Full Access to the real Accounts mailbox, or a verified GMT-owned shared mailbox route. Do not point a shared-mailbox trigger at the nonexistent legacy address. Prove an actual new run before replay.

acceptedRecordJson: An array of legacy dated row objects
One schemaVersion 2 replace-pay-month envelope with rows and stable recordId

routing.authority: The Date field of every daily row; weekStart, weekEnd, subject and receive date are not payroll dates
routing.periodPolicy: Use pay-periods.js: the four-week cycle anchored 2026-08-24 runs through 2026-09-20. Payroll is processed on Friday 2026-09-18. The cycle-end date and payroll Friday are separate dates; daily row dates determine the pay month.
routing.mixedPayMonths: Partition a legacy attachment into one per-pay-month row array. Never rewrite its Date values to fit the named week. Replacement snapshots must belong to exactly one declared pay month.
checksBeforeExcel: Parse controlled record JSON and require one verified employee identity and a stable source record ID
Reject inconsistent employee names/emails, invalid or duplicate Date values, and declared months that disagree with Date
Hold future worked days and off-roster default worked rows for source review; do not infer absence
Ensure the exact company workbook exists and contains only Daily Entries and Weekly Totals

writeOrder: Validate the source attachment and partition by dated pay month
For each protected pay-month correction, post flow_started for the correction record using the provider run ID and run start timestamp before any workbook write
Run the tested pay-month register v3 Office Script against each exact company workbook

Require Office Script read-back to verify every accepted row by source ID, Date, Action and normalized payroll cells; post workbook_verified only when the verified rows exactly match the correction source
Upsert the protected list/history item using the stable source record ID after the workbook update succeeds
Post flow_completed for the correction record only after all partitions and index writes succeed
Mark the message processed only after all partitions and index writes succeed

authentication.secretStorage: Store as a secured Power Automate environment variable or approved secret-store value and as a Cloudflare Worker secret. Never put the value in this repository, a flow definition export, a workbook, or a browser request. Mark HTTP action inputs and outputs secure.

runIdentity.flowRunId: The Power Automate workflow run name; stable for all callbacks in one run.
runIdentity.runStartedAt: The Power Automate run start timestamp as RFC 3339; use the same value for every event in that run.
runIdentity.correctionRecordId: The existing protected correction record ID. Do not accept it from an unauthenticated browser or substitute an Outlook message ID.

flow_started.when: After source validation and pay-month routing, before any workbook write.

workbook_verified.when: After the Office Script re-reads the workbook and verifies every correction row; before the protected history index is updated.

flow_completed.when: After workbook verification and all protected history/index actions succeed.

flow_failed.when: When processing fails; post from the failure handler with the failed stage and a short, sanitised error. Never include names, email addresses, tokens, or full action outputs in safeError.

body.safeError: One or more dated rows did not match after the workbook write.

workbookVerification.requiredCondition: Only post workbook_verified when unverifiedRecordIds is empty, verifiedRows exactly covers correction attachment row IDs and Dates, and created + updated + unchanged equals the verified row count.
workbookVerification.noClientRouting: The flow derives the employee workbook path from validated source data and approved pay-month rules. The callback body never carries or selects a workbook path, SharePoint item ID, employee, or tenant.

retryPolicy.identity: Retry a callback with the same recordId, flowRunId, runStartedAt, event, and evidence. Matching retries are idempotent; conflicting evidence is rejected.
retryPolicy.callbackOutage: Retry only the failed receipt HTTP action with bounded backoff while the existing workbook and history work continues. Do not replay the whole flow or repeat a workbook write because a receipt call failed. If any receipt remains pending at run end, retry pending receipts in event order with the original identity and evidence when service returns; do not repeat the workbook action.
retryPolicy.startOutage: A flow_started callback outage must not block or duplicate payroll processing. Keep the receipt pending and do not submit later receipt events until flow_started is accepted; retry pending receipts in order, including after the processing run if needed.
retryPolicy.failureOutage: If the receipt service is unavailable, a failure receipt may also be unavailable. The portal must show the stage as not reported until the original run receipt is accepted.

corrections.queueRequirement: Regenerate each held correction with the controlled GMT Timesheet Record JSON attachment before delivery; the existing XLSX/CSV pair alone is insufficient
corrections.idempotency: Reuse the original stable record ID or an explicit correction ID linked to it; do not create another independent active employee month
corrections.audit: Keep editor identity, edit time, affected Date values, and source message/run ID in the protected record; notify the employee and both Accounts recipients

certification.perSource: Source message and attachment hash -> new successful trigger/run -> Run script workbook path and created/updated/unchanged counts -> downloaded SharePoint workbook cell comparison -> portal history projection
certification.perEmployee: One active company workbook, two required tabs, all evidenced dated rows, accurate numeric break and total hours, weekly/month totals, resolved or explicitly provisional source conflicts
certification.holdUntil: Do not release the three protected corrections or send reviewer workbooks before the trigger, route, script and one isolated test replay are proven
certification.receiptProof: A portal Verified state requires an accepted workbook_verified callback whose rows match the protected correction attachment; an email sent status or flow run alone is insufficient.
